shared_interfaces.file_rules: Flat allowlisted ASCII basenames only; reject absolute/traversal/Unicode/NUL/symlink/hardlink/special files. No arbitrary host paths. Current active solution files only; previous source snapshots are trusted internal state.
shared_interfaces.bridge_transport: Production extension spawns one fixed trusted bridge program with fixed argv, shell:false. One bounded UTF-8 JSON object on stdin: {action,arguments}. Response one bounded JSON object: {ok:true,result:<strict action result>} OR {ok:false,error:<safe enum>}. Never include arbitrary error text/stdout/data. Broker path/config is trusted deployment, not model arguments. Fixture bridge may be a separate fixed test program.
shared_interfaces.execution_admission: At-most-once fence PER immutable intent, not per campaign. Distinct admitted development snapshots may run; duplicate same intent/restart/concurrent calls cannot launch twice. All intents/costs preserved; uncertain id binding blocks further launches, never auto retry.
shared_interfaces.generated_solution_api: solution.py defines fit_predict(train: pandas.DataFrame, features: pandas.DataFrame) -> one-dimensional finite numeric predictions in features row order. train has Id and SalePrice; features has Id but no target. Runner drops no IDs/rows and trusted scorer checks exact order. Generated code may choose preprocessing/estimator/hyperparameters freely within installed packages and resource bounds. No baked RF/Ridge/boosting menu.
shared_interfaces.data_contract: Source positional80percent outer prefix; inner train_test_split of outer prefix with test_size.25 random_state1 shuffleTrue stratifyNone. Trusted preparer emits train_inner.csv,dev_features.csv,dev_targets.csv,train_outer.csv,hidden_features.csv,hidden_targets.csv; no raw rows/labels returned to LLM. Worker may use fake tables only.
shared_interfaces.development_run: Generated container gets exact solution.py, train_inner.csv WITH training target, dev_features.csv WITHOUT dev target, and private output mount. Trusted external dev scorer holds dev_targets.csv. Only aggregate MAE and bounded public identity/status pass model.
shared_interfaces.final_run: Controller selects one dev code hash from its dev evidence using final_refit intent; broker locks selection BEFORE final fit. Selected solution.py unchanged, refits train_outer.csv and predicts hidden_features.csv. hidden_targets.csv NEVER mounted. Final score after prediction lock and controller termination, never returned to controller.
shared_interfaces.private_output: predictions.csv exact Id,SalePrice with features IDs, no agent-readable outputs or arbitrary logs. stdout/stderr discarded/quarantined with hard byte caps. Trusted status/error enums only.
shared_interfaces.budget_status: Implementation uses explicit passed frozen resource caps; campaign/model numerical ceilings still being finalized. Nothing defaults to unbounded.
shared_interfaces.ORX_owner: Only orx exp run/status/cancel/logs authority owns scientific runs. Adapter may stage code, bind intent/runid and sanitize logs; no replacement lifecycle registry/supervisor or arbitrary shell. Production ORX mapping is root-owned.

required_before_real_launch: Actual fabricated-provider/host sentinel/container negatives, all code hashes and exact protocol, immutable task-bound method/runtime review; no actual fits/API calls in implementation lanes.
